def ftable(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']

    S={(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g[a][b]==1}

            y=sum(1 for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if (i+dy,j+dx) in S)
            yy=sum(1 for dy in (-1,0,1) for dx in (-1,0,1) if (dy,dx)!=(0,0) and (i+dy,j+dx) in S)
            zd=sum(1 for p,qd in S if abs(p-i)<=1 and abs(qd-j)<=1 and (p,qd)!=(i,j)) - y
            z8=sum(1 for dy in (-1,0,1) for dx in (-1,0,1) if (dy,dx)!=(0,0) and 0<=i+dy<H and 0<=j+dx<W and g[i+dy][j+dx]==0)
            z4=sum(1 for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+dy<H and 0<=j+dx<W and g[i+dy][j+dx]==0)
            insb=r0:=min(p for p,_ in S); c0=min(q for _,q in S); r1=max(p for p,_ in S); c1=max(q for _,q in S)
            inbbox=r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1
            onb=i in (0,H-1) or j in (0,W-1)
            res.append((k,i,j,o[i][j],y,yy,zd,z8,z4,inbbox,onb))

# Gather per-cell features across demos, target label = out value.
def feats(g, go, name):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); S={(p,q) for p in range(H) for q in range(W) if g[p][q]==1}
    rows=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==0:
                ns8=sum(1 for dy in(-1,0,1) for dx in(-1,0,1) if (dy,dx)!=(0,0) and g[i+dy][j+dx] in [1,2,3] or True)
                nshape=sum(1 for dy in(-1,0,1) for dx in(-1,0,1) if (dy,dx)!=(0,0) and g[i+dy][j+dx]==1 and 0<=i+dy<H and 0<=j+dx<W)
                # use only 1s present in THIS input
                row=[('nb',nshape),'border' if (i in (0,H-1) or j in (0,W-1)) else 'inner','inbx',0,'col0',0]
                rows.append({'k':name,'i':i,'j':j,'out':go[i][j],'nb':nshape,'bdr':i in (0,H-1) or j in (0,W-1)})
    return rows
